_note: H3 reads a sectioned brief, not a pile of style words. This file is the whole of that protocol: the tag names, the retention words the model actually responds to, and which of them each starting point picks. The panel shows plain language and sends back ids, so nothing here has to be typed by hand. Add a recipe to offer a new starting point; add a role to offer a new way for a slot to bind.

video.label: keep the shot
video.note: the camera move and the timing are followed; everything else is open
video.line: fully_preserved - the camera move, the blocking and the timing.

video.label: keep it exactly
video.note: the clip is the scene: its surfaces come through as they already look
video.line: fully_preserved - the camera move, the blocking, the timing, and every surface exactly as it already appears.

video.label: loose reference
video.note: only the energy and pacing; the scene is invented
video.line: weak_reference only - the energy and pacing; the scene itself is new.

picture.label: the subject
picture.note: who or what is in the shot: the design is held exactly
picture.role: identity anchor - the character design, exactly
picture.line: fully_preserved - the design exactly as drawn.

picture.label: the look
picture.note: the medium and palette: every surface is redrawn to match
picture.role: style anchor - the medium, line, palette and texture
picture.line: attribute_transfer - every surface in frame is redrawn in this style, buildings, smoke, ground and crowd included. Nothing stays photographic.

picture.label: a hint
picture.note: a loose influence on the mood, nothing held
picture.line: weak_reference only - a loose influence on the mood.

recipes.label: full restyle
recipes.shot: The whole frame is one drawing - <the medium, the line weight, the palette> - moving with the shot.

recipes.label: character swap
recipes.shot: The shot stays as filmed; only the subject is replaced, lit to match the plate.

recipes.label: follow the plate
recipes.note: for a layer stack: what you built in Layers is the scene, and the model keeps it
recipes.shot: <what the shot is, in one line: the plate already carries the look>

recipes.label: new scene
recipes.shot: <what the shot is: subject, place, medium, palette, lens, grain>

recipes.label: first → last
recipes.shot: The shot begins on the first frame. At about one second ... At about two seconds ... It settles into the last frame and holds.

sound_default: the natural sound of the scene.
_needs: Which slot a recipe actually works through. A workflow that cannot honour that slot's role is not offered the recipe: full restyle is a picture restyling the scene, so a model whose pictures only carry identity never shows it.
